verdict.rationale: Activepieces documents a REST API under /docs/endpoints, covering API-key authentication via a Bearer token and keys generated in the platform dashboard. That shows an API reference exists, but nothing in the pack shows it is interactive or has runnable examples. The OpenAPI/Swagger probe returned 404 on every candidate path, so there is no machine-readable spec that a try-it console could be built from. Missing for 10: interactive try-it console, runnable request examples, a published OpenAPI spec, and independent or hands-on corroboration of the reference.
